paper_metadata.title: Fabrication of high-strength Mg-Gd-Zn-Zr alloys via differential-thermal extrusion

evidence.quote: A high-strength Mg-Gd-Zn-Zr alloy developed by a novel extrusion method called differential-thermal extrusion (DTE) was detailed characterized
The Mg-15Gd-1Zn-0.4Zr (wt.%) alloy was warm extruded with a novel method called the differential-thermal extrusion (DTE).
